# Acceptance-suite fixtures

Test data owned by the spec. Implementations must accept the `valid` fixtures and reject the `invalid` ones; do not edit fixtures to make an implementation pass. Change them only together with the spec or an ADR.

| Folder | Used by | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `manifests/{valid,invalid}` | M0S-E06-01 | Plugin manifests. Each invalid file has a `$comment` naming the broken rule. |
| `events/{valid,invalid}` | M0S-E10-01, M0S-E13-04 | CloudEvents envelopes (`dataclass`/`actorid` extensions). |
| `theme-json/{valid,invalid}` | M0S-E13-01 | `theme.json` documents checked against the theme schema only. |
| `themes/<name>/` | M0S-E13-03, M0S-E13-04, M0S-E13-09 | Complete theme packages. `themes/expected.json` lists the expected validation outcome (valid, error codes, warning codes) per package. |
| `lockfiles/` | M0S-E02-05 | A clean and a compromised `pnpm-lock.yaml` (May 2026 TanStack versions). |
| `licence-map/{good,bad}` | M0S-E02-04 | Tiny trees with SPDX headers in the right and wrong places. |
| `python/` | M0S-E01-02 | Import probes, linted via `ruff --stdin-filename` as if they lived in a plugin or in core. |
| `lint/` | M0S-E01-03, M0S-E13-08 | TSX probes, linted via `eslint --stdin --stdin-filename` as if they lived in `plugins/official/tasks/web`. |

## Theme packages

`themes/` is generated by `_generators/make_fixtures.py`, which also proves each palette with the suite's own contrast maths (`tests/_support/colour.py`):

- `valid-minimal` passes every rule with zero warnings. It bundles **Fixture Sans**, a tiny real WOFF2 font generated by the script (MIT, project-owned).
- `warn-*` packages are valid but must raise exactly one warning code.
- `invalid-*` packages must be rejected with at least the listed error code.
- Some cases are built at test time in a temporary copy instead of being committed: a symlink leaving the theme folder (`asset.path`), a 2.1 MB image (`asset.size`) and nine fonts (`asset.limit`).

The live test stack mounts this folder read-only as an extra themes path (`deploy/compose/compose.test.yaml`, M0S-E11-01), so the API tests can select `valid-minimal` and see the invalid ones listed as invalid.

Regenerate after changing the contract:

```sh
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r tests/fixtures/_generators/requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python -I tests/fixtures/_generators/make_fixtures.py
```
